figurative_meaning_en: without any claim or right; baseless or groundless
similar_in_english: without a leg to stand on
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কথা লাদাবি বলে কেউ বিশ্বাস করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: No one will believe such groundless talk.
history: Derived from Arabic phrase 'la da'wa' meaning 'no claim', commonly used in Bengali to denote lack of justification.
note: The idiom reflects Persian-Arabic influence on Bengali language due to historical Islamic rule in Bengal.
